mapper.sql: ifi90_config_id AS config_id, ifi90_if_cd AS if_code, ifi90_if_nm AS if_name, ifi90_if_type AS if_type, ifi90_if_type_nm AS if_type_name, ifi90_local_host AS local_host, ifi90_local_port AS local_port, ifi90_local_account AS local_account, ifi90_local_pw_dec AS local_pw_dec, ifi90_local_path AS local_path, ifi90_local_key AS local_key, ifi90_target_host AS target_host, ifi90_target_port AS target_port, ifi90_target_account AS target_account, ifi90_target_pw_dec AS target_pw_dec, ifi90_target_path AS target_path, ifi90_target_key1 AS target_key, ifi90_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( SELECT ifi90_config.* , f_cdnm('InterfaceType', ifi90_if_type, 0, f_today()) AS ifi90_if_type_nm , to_decrypts(ifi90_local_pw) AS ifi90_local_pw_dec , to_decrypts(ifi90_target_pw) AS ifi90_target_pw_dec FROM ifi90_config WHERE ifi90_if_type LIKE #{p.ifType} ) t WHERE UPPER(CONCAT( ifi90_if_cd, ifi90_if_nm, ifi90_if_type_nm, ifi90_local_host, ifi90_target_host , ifi90_note )) LIKE UPPER(#{p.searchText}) ORDER BY ifi90_if_cd, ifi90_if_type

SELECT FROM ( SELECT ifi90_config.* , f_cdnm('InterfaceType', ifi90_if_type, 0, f_today()) AS ifi90_if_type_nm , to_decrypts(ifi90_local_pw) AS ifi90_local_pw_dec , to_decrypts(ifi90_target_pw) AS ifi90_target_pw_dec FROM ifi90_config WHERE ifi90_config_id = #{configId} ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ifi90_config (ifi90_config_id, ifi90_if_cd, ifi90_if_nm, ifi90_if_type, ifi90_local_host, ifi90_local_port, ifi90_local_account, ifi90_local_path, ifi90_local_key, ifi90_target_host, ifi90_target_port, ifi90_target_account, ifi90_target_path, ifi90_target_key1, ifi90_note) VALUES (#{id}, #{r.ifCode}, #{r.ifName}, #{r.ifType}, #{r.localHost}, #{r.localPort}, #{r.localAccount}, #{r.localPath}, #{r.localKey}, #{r.targetHost}, #{r.targetPort}, #{r.targetAccount}, #{r.targetPath}, #{r.targetKey}, #{r.note})
